description:
The transfers endpoint must accept valid requests, reject invalid ones with the right status
  code and a clear error, and never fail with a server error (5xx) whatever the input.

elements.name: Valid transfer returns 201 and the created transaction

steps.name: I send a valid transfer request
the response status should be 201
the response should contain the created transaction
the transfer should appear in GET /api/transactions

elements.name: missing fromAccount is rejected

steps.name: I send a transfer with "missing fromAccount"
the response status should be 400
the error code should be "MISSING_FIELDS"
the error details should name the fields "fromAccount"

steps.name: I send a transfer with "missing toAccount"
